_readme: FIAT UI GLYPHS - the purse on the top bar (10 Oct, Bar-C): scrap and the three salvages, one job each, written straight to art/ui/<name>.png ('single'). 64 x 64, drawn at 26 px on the top bar with mipmaps: one bold silhouette each, in the same style as cash.png and notes.png.

Run: godot --headless --script res://tools/pixellab_batch_v2.gd ++ --manifest res://tools/pixellab_ui_purse_manifest.json   (++ --dry-run to list; one that came out wrong: ++ --only <name> ++ --force). These names are new: nothing painted is written over.
Until a file is there the bar draws the engine's line glyph in the currency's tone; a painting shows as it is (UI.glyph_mono), a line drawing is tinted.

jobs.description: A realistic painted pixel-art still-life of a small heap of scrap metal - bent nails, a hinge, a twist of copper wire, a cog, a broken padlock - piled loosely, seen from above at a slight angle. One object centred and filling the frame, a single bold silhouette that still reads at a quarter of this size, soft directional overcast daylight, natural material rendering with painterly shading; no black outlines, no flat cel shading, not anime, not a cartoon, not a glossy video-game icon; the look of a real object photographed on a grey day in a country that has run out of money. Muted cool northern palette, worn and repaired, nothing new. Nothing else in the frame, no hands, no person, no text, no logos, a plain dark neutral background.
